glosses: To express contempt and disrespect for someone or something, or to act accordingly.

examples.text: If you cancel this contract, you're basically pissing on me and all the work I've done for you.
You just completely pissed on my job performance here.

glosses: To reject (a person, an idea, etc.)

examples.text: She wants us to work outside in the dark? Piss on that. I'm going home early.
You've done nothing but complain the whole time we've been here. Piss on you. I'm done listening to you.

examples.text: The fox is a very dangerous animal. First, he can attack people; he can bite if he feels cornered without any hope of escape. Worse, he can piss on you, and his urine can be deadly if it's from a female with a liver disease.
